## GET /api/v1/member/exercises?limit=50 (no search): 1 query(ies)

### query 1
```sql
[20101]
      Executed DbCommand (3ms) [Parameters=[@__memberId_0='?' (DbType = Guid), @__p_1='?' (DbType = Int32)], CommandType='Text', CommandTimeout='30']
      SELECT t."EXERCISE_ID", t."EXERCISE_NAME", t."EXERCISE_MIN_LEVEL", t."EXERCISE_PRIMARY_EQUIPMENT_ID", e0."EQUIPMENT_NAME", t."EXERCISE_SECONDARY_EQUIPMENT_ID", e1."EQUIPMENT_NAME"
      FROM (
          SELECT e."EXERCISE_ID", e."EXERCISE_MIN_LEVEL", e."EXERCISE_NAME", e."EXERCISE_PRIMARY_EQUIPMENT_ID", e."EXERCISE_SECONDARY_EQUIPMENT_ID"
          FROM "EXERCISES" AS e
          WHERE e."EXERCISE_IS_ACTIVE" AND (e."EXERCISE_COACH_ID" IS NULL OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM "MEMBER_COACHES" AS m
              WHERE m."MEMBER_ID" = @__memberId_0 AND m."COACH_ID" = e."EXERCISE_COACH_ID"))
          ORDER BY e."EXERCISE_NAME", e."EXERCISE_ID"
          LIMIT @__p_1
      ) AS t
      LEFT JOIN "EQUIPMENT" AS e0 ON t."EXERCISE_PRIMARY_EQUIPMENT_ID" = e0."EQUIPMENT_ID"
      LEFT JOIN "EQUIPMENT" AS e1 ON t."EXERCISE_SECONDARY_EQUIPMENT_ID" = e1."EQUIPMENT_ID"
      ORDER BY t."EXERCISE_NAME", t."EXERCISE_ID"
```
